subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.

She is an __epitome__ of grace.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (Example)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"epitome"** refers to a perfect example or embodiment of a particular quality or type. (सार / आदर्श उदाहरण)

 
 
• **Example:** Mahatma Gandhi is often considered the epitome of non-violence and truth.
 
 
 
• **"Example"** signifies a person or thing regarded as an ideal model or perfect representation of something. (उदाहरण)
 
 
• **Example:** Her hard work and dedication are an example for everyone to follow.
 
 
 
• Hence, "epitome" and "example" are synonymous as both indicate a perfect representation of a certain quality.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (Example)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Admirer** (प्रशंसक): A person who has a great respect or liking for someone or something.

 
 
• **Example:** She is an admirer of classical art and music.
 
 
 
• **Believer** (आस्तिक / विश्वास करने वाला): Someone who accepts something as true or has faith in something.
 
 
• **Example:** He is a firm believer in the power of education to transform lives.
 
 
 
• **Destroyer** (विध्वंसक): A person or thing that causes destruction or ruins something.
 
 
• **Example:** The storm was the destroyer of many homes in the village.
